newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 17.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 17.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Insurer announced a rise in annual net profit of A$66.6 million and a marginally lower dividend before the market opened on Monday.
Base metals miner said delays in landowner talks at the Century zinc project should be resolved eventually and not affect supply to its Budel smelter in the Netherlands.
Australia's largest grocery retailer issues half year profit result to January 5.

The nation's leading biscuit maker has taken stock off the shelves in New South Wales and Queensland due to an extortion threat which begins today. Company announced a first half profit slump last Friday and predicted the extortion threat will cost A$5 million a week.
Western Australia gold miner issues half year profit result during the day.

Two of Australia's big four banks, NAB and CBA, have announced cuts in their standard variable mortgage rates to 7.55 percent. The other two are expected to announce similar rates in the next few days.
